classification.difficultyReason: Identify both semicircular boundary arcs and the straight perimeter segment, then combine their lengths exactly.

content.prompt: Find the exact perimeter of this shape. The curved sections are semicircles.

spec.description: An upper semicircle with a 20 cm diameter and a smaller upper semicircle with a 10 cm diameter forming an inward boundary over the right half. The left 10 cm baseline is a solid perimeter edge; the right 10 cm baseline is a red dashed construction diameter with its midpoint marked.
spec.mathematics: Large semicircle radius 10 cm; small semicircle radius 5 cm. The perimeter comprises both semicircular arcs and the left 10 cm straight segment.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; no perimeter answer or calculated arc lengths.

answer.worked:
The dashed diameter is a construction line, so it is not part of the perimeter.
$$\begin{align*}
l_{\text{large}} &= \frac12\times\pi\times20=10\pi\text{ cm}\\
l_{\text{small}} &= \frac12\times\pi\times10=5\pi\text{ cm}\\
P &= 10+10\pi+5\pi\\
P &= (15\pi+10)\text{ cm}
\end{align*}$$
